Name: Social Haley
Author: witchdoctor26
Description:
This mod expands Haley's schedule throughout Stardew Valley and helps add depth to her character arc throughout the game.

[size=4]Mod Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Includes four new locations on Haley's schedule including the town square, saloon, community center, and spa.
[*]Location specific dialogue
[*]Sprites and character portrait for the spa.  
[/list]
Specific Features
[spoiler]
[*]Saloon on Friday nights includes new dialogue at all the even heart levels
[*]Mingles with Jodi and Caroline once married on her Monday trips to town
[*]Takes gardening lessons from Evelyn at 6-hearts
[*]Travels to the spa in the winter on Wednesdays and includes sprites and portraits for the pool area
[*]Takes photos inside the craft room at the community center on Thursdays when completed
[/spoiler]
[size=4]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Social Haley
Manifest.Description: Makes Haley more of a dynamic and interesting character. Includes a new schedule and dialog.
